commands.cmd:
bash -c 'export MCP_AUTO_OPEN_ENABLED=false
set -euo pipefail
INSPECTOR=$(command -v mcp-inspector) || { echo "mcp-inspector not on PATH" >&2; exit 1; }
RESOLVED=$(readlink -f "$INSPECTOR")
echo "mcp-inspector resolves: $INSPECTOR -> $RESOLVED"
PREFIX="${RESOLVED%%/lib/node_modules/*}"
NPM_LS=$(npm ls --global --prefix "$PREFIX" --depth=0 --json)
echo "npm ls --depth=0: $NPM_LS"
INSTALLED_VERSION=$(printf '"'"'%s'"'"' "$NPM_LS" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['"'"'dependencies'"'"']['"'"'@modelcontextprotocol/inspector'"'"']['"'"'version'"'"'])")
echo "installed version (npm ls, not --version): $INSTALLED_VERSION"
python3 -c "
import json, glob
stack_versions = [c['"'"'version'"'"'] for c in json.load(open('"'"'manifests/stack.json'"'"'))['"'"'components'"'"'] if c['"'"'id'"'"'] == '"'"'mcp-inspector'"'"']
winner_pins = sorted({w['"'"'pin'"'"'] for f in glob.glob('"'"'catalogs/landscape/*.json'"'"') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('"'"'layers'"'"', []) for w in (l.get('"'"'winners'"'"') or []) if w.get('"'"'component_id'"'"') == '"'"'mcp-inspector'"'"'})
print('"'"'manifests/stack.json version(s):'"'"', stack_versions)
print('"'"'landscape winner pin(s):'"'"', winner_pins)
assert stack_versions == ['"'"'2.7.0'"'"'], stack_versions
assert winner_pins == ['"'"'2.7.0'"'"'], winner_pins
"
test "$INSTALLED_VERSION" = "2.7.0"
echo "PASS: installed 2.7.0 matches manifests/stack.json and the mcp-surfaces landscape winner pin"'

bash -c 'export MCP_AUTO_OPEN_ENABLED=false
set -euo pipefail
export MCP_AUTO_OPEN_ENABLED=false
INSPECTOR=$(command -v mcp-inspector) || { echo "mcp-inspector not on PATH" >&2; exit 1; }
QMD=$(command -v qmd) || { echo "qmd not on PATH" >&2; exit 1; }
T=$(mktemp -d)
trap '"'"'rm -rf "$T"'"'"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$T/docs"
MARK="mcpi-check-$$-$RANDOM"
printf '"'"'# Scratch fixture\n\n%s appears exactly once in this fresh fixture file.\n'"'"' "$MARK" > "$T/docs/note.md"
( cd "$T" && "$QMD" init >/dev/null && "$QMD" collection add "$T/docs" --name scratch >/dev/null && "$QMD" update >/dev/null )
printf '"'"'{"mcpServers":{"qmd":{"type":"stdio","command":"%s","args":["mcp"]}}}'"'"' "$QMD" > "$T/mcp.json"
LIST_JSON=$(timeout 60 "$INSPECTOR" --cli --config "$T/mcp.json" --server qmd --method tools/list --format json --stored-auth-only --cwd "$T")
python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
names = sorted(t['"'"'name'"'"'] for t in d['"'"'result'"'"']['"'"'tools'"'"'])
expected = ['"'"'get'"'"', '"'"'multi_get'"'"', '"'"'query'"'"', '"'"'status'"'"']
assert names == expected, (names, expected)
print('"'"'tools/list OK, tool names:'"'"', names)
" "$LIST_JSON"
CALL_ARGS=$(printf '"'"'{"searches":[{"type":"lex","query":"%s"}],"limit":5,"collections":["scratch"],"rerank":false}'"'"' "$MARK")
CALL_JSON=$(timeout 60 "$INSPECTOR" --cli --config "$T/mcp.json" --server qmd --method tools/call --tool-name query --tool-args-json "$CALL_ARGS" --format json --stored-auth-only --cwd "$T")
python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
mark = sys.argv[2]
text = d['"'"'result'"'"']['"'"'content'"'"'][0]['"'"'text'"'"']
hits = d['"'"'result'"'"']['"'"'structuredContent'"'"']['"'"'results'"'"']
assert '"'"'Found 1 result'"'"' in text and mark in text, text
assert len(hits) == 1 and hits[0]['"'"'file'"'"'] == '"'"'scratch/note.md'"'"' and hits[0]['"'"'score'"'"'] == 1, hits
print('"'"'tools/call query OK, hit:'"'"', hits[0]['"'"'file'"'"'], hits[0]['"'"'docid'"'"'])
" "$CALL_JSON" "$MARK"
ERR_FILE="$T/err.json"
set +e
timeout 60 "$INSPECTOR" --cli --config "$T/mcp.json" --server qmd --method tools/call --tool-name does_not_exist_probe --tool-args-json '"'"'{}'"'"' --format json --stored-auth-only --cwd "$T" >/dev/null 2>"$ERR_FILE"
RC=$?
set -e
echo "positive-control exit code: $RC"
test "$RC" -eq 5
ERR_JSON=$(tail -n 1 "$ERR_FILE")
python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
assert d['"'"'error'"'"']['"'"'code'"'"'] == '"'"'tool_not_found'"'"', d
assert '"'"'does_not_exist_probe'"'"' in d['"'"'error'"'"']['"'"'message'"'"'], d
print('"'"'positive control OK: exit 5,'"'"', d['"'"'error'"'"'])
" "$ERR_JSON"
echo "ALL CHECKS PASSED"'

reviews.ref: Reproduce: re-ran cmd0 (npm ls readback; does not invoke the inspector) and cmd1 verbatim with --cli and MCP_AUTO_OPEN_ENABLED=false against a local stdio qmd on a temp fixture: same tools/list, query hit and exit-5 tool_not_found; no leftover processes, no browser. Adequacy-checked: (1) layer role passes (the Inspector inspects a real MCP server and calls its tools); (2) positive control passes (nonexistent tool exits 5, tool_not_found); (4) passes (component_id mcp-inspector is the mcp-surfaces winner, 2.7.0, pin_matches True). MISSING POINT 3 (backed claims) on one claim sentence: 'QMD stdio MCP server isolated in a temporary HOME' is contradicted by the retained command, which sets no HOME or XDG variable; isolation comes from a project-local index made by qmd init in a temp directory (I confirmed no scratch collection reached the global qmd config). The limitation's 'QMD 2.8.3' also has no retained command (qmd --version prints 2.8.3). Fix: reword to a project-local index in a temp directory and add a qmd --version command.
